name: areanet/contentfly-skeleton
description: Contentfly — project skeleton and development repository. Pulls in the framework as the package areanet/contentfly.

notes: THIS IS THE PROJECT'S MANIFEST (since 007-001-0004). Until then ONE manifest
carried framework, project code and plugins — exactly the mix that made an
update impossible: whoever wanted a new framework version only got it by
overwriting the tree that also held their own code.
THIS REPOSITORY IS ALSO THE SKELETON. The root minus the entries that only serve
development (tests/, tools/, an_project/, the gate configurations) is what a
project starts from. A separate skeleton package is deliberately not created —
it would drift apart because nobody runs it, while the full suite runs here on
every commit. Reasoning and rejected alternatives:
an_project/docs/architecture.md, Key decisions, 2026-09-11.
THE path SOURCE is the reason the package route is actually checked here and not
just described: composer install places areanet/contentfly under
vendor/areanet/contentfly, and the autoloader loads the framework from there.
Anything that still silently assumes it lives in the same tree shows up.
WHAT IS HERE AND WHY:
vlucas/phpdotenv   used by custom/config.php, i.e. the template, i.e. the
project. Counted: 0 hits in lib/, 1 in custom/.
require-dev        PHPUnit, PHPStan, Rector — tools of the repository where
development happens.
Custom\, Plugins\  the project's two slots.
Tests\             the framework's suite runs from here against an
installation; it belongs to development, not to what
the package delivers.
config.platform    is at 8.3 because the suite is green on it and the
pipeline runs it against it. It is green on PHP 8.4 as
well — last measured on 2026-09-11. The number carries its
date because it goes stale with every story. A library
package must not prescribe this; that is why it is here.
config.audit       The gate runs against this lock.
The jump to PHP 8.5 is a step of its own. What used to block it is gone:
ellumilel/php-excel-writer capped at php ^5.4|^7.0 and went away with its
consumer, the ExportController, in 012-001-0003. The state is documented in
an_project/docs/technical.md.
an_project/docs/abhaengigkeiten-inventar.md is a SNAPSHOT from 2026-09-08. It
describes the tree BEFORE epic 006. It is not the source for today's package
state — the two composer.json files and composer.lock are.
